name: Eschwege (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Eschwege (a white wall with two towers and a tree on red).
history: Municipal flag of Eschwege; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Eschwege arms — wall with towers on red
